title: Common Start
statement: A search box wants to suggest the longest text that every saved search starts with. Given a list of words, return the longest string that is a prefix of every word. Return "" if the list is empty or the words share no prefix.

answerKey.pattern: Compare characters column by column across all words, stopping at the first mismatch or the end of the shortest word
keyPoints: Check position 0, 1, 2, ... of the first word against the same position in every other word
Stop when a word is too short or has a different character there
Return the first word cut at that position
answerKey.spaceComplexity: O(1) extra, plus the returned string
edgeCases: An empty word makes the answer ""
One word is a prefix of another
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Sort the words and compare only the first and last: O(n log n · k)

hints: The answer can never be longer than the shortest word.
Check one position at a time: is character i the same in every word?
Stop at the first position where some word is too short or differs, and return the first word cut there.
